title: Canon in D
source: Ground bass (D A B F# G D G A) and the first violin's opening lines (F#5 E5 D5 C#5 B4 A4 B4 C#5, then the second quarter-note line D5 C#5 B4 A4 G4 F#4 G4 E4, then the eighth-note variation D F# A G F# D F# E / D B D A G B A G, which the score places in the octave below, starting on D4 after the line ends on E4) read from the public-domain Mutopia Project edition of Canon per 3 Violini e Basso (IMSLP source) and the Wikipedia 'Pachelbel's Canon' score; all values doubled (bass in half notes, the quarter-note lines in half notes, the eighth-note variation in quarters), giving 12 bars (canonA and canonB in half notes over the ground bass, canonC in quarters; the bass repeats three times), and the arrangement and fingering are written for this project.
